## History

Barry was a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who lived at the [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) property. He kept a flat-bottomed dory that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) used to learn how to row. Later, he picked up [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from Aunt Josephine's home at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and drove the girls back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after their trip to the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. ## Quotes

> "and I can’t prevent her, for her father aids and abets her. She’s always poring over a book. I’m glad she has the prospect of a playmate—perhaps it will take her more out-of-doors."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "I don’t think you are a fit little girl for Diana to associate with. You’d better go home and behave yourself."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)

> "Come in. And this is the little girl you have adopted, I suppose?"
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015)

> "Diana, you might take Anne out into the garden and show her your flowers. It will be better for you than straining your eyes over that book. She reads entirely too much—"
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Barry is the father of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). When [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), their family home, the girls struck up an immediate and solemn friendship in the garden.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), +7 more_

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--barry.md)

Barry is an old friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) through her close bond with his daughter, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Following a trip to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), Barry drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) back home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on a scenic evening drive.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P22](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P27](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0027), +5 more_
